watches.summary: Sunrise on New Year’s Day opens play aboard the skyship; introductions remain in that morning.
Next morning; a guild wait and a few minutes inspecting the mace occur before the afternoon departure.
The guild visit ends after lunch, probably two or three in the afternoon.
Dinner begins around 5–6 p.m.: late afternoon or dusk.
After sleep, the next morning; Faldrak reports an earlier guild visit before brunch.
Ladder returns with Faldrak at about ten, near the morning/midday boundary.
